dispositions.topic_text: First-release owner-interface guidance for room-name and alias rules
Kernel approval acquisition and denial, cancellation, or expiry behavior in agent-write flows
dispositions.reason: R0-99 sets only the effect class of the agent's writes in Registry's manifest record. How Kernel stops a run for the owner's approval of the exact request, applies a standing approval, and what a refusal, cancellation or expiry does to the run are Kernel's (case cabinet-kernel, K-08, K-09); Registry receives either the approved call or none, and its flows are the same either way.
